notes: Fixed: recording a stream said "Recording started..." whether or not it had - if the file could not be created, most often for lack of free storage, the message appeared anyway and the only way to find out was to go looking for a file that was never there; it now says what actually happened, and why when it couldn't start. A recording that ended on its own, because the station was changed, playback stopped, or the connection dropped mid-write, just went quiet with no word on whether anything had been saved; every ending is now reported and names the file it saved. The record button also appeared on podcasts, local files and YouTube videos, where it wrote a copy into your Music folder under the wrong name and, for a video, the wrong type entirely - it is now offered only for live radio and TV. Installing a downloaded update could crash the app on devices with no package installer of their own, at the worst possible moment, on the tap right after a download that had just succeeded; it now explains the problem and leaves the file where you can install it yourself. Opening the "allow installing apps" settings screen, and sharing what's playing, could each crash on devices that can't handle them. Improved: deleting a bookmark can be undone - it was a single tap with no confirmation, destroying something you chose and possibly named, while removing a favourite already offered an Undo. The sleep timer now says whether it is running: to a screen reader the button read "Sleep Timer" whether a timer was set or not, with the countdown beside it as a separate unexplained stop, so the button now states the time remaining itself and the menu's "Off" says when it will cancel a running timer. Every dialog now announces itself by name when it opens and its title reads as a heading, which was true of some dialogs and not others. The update dialog's "Skip" now says which version it skips and that it won't be offered again - it and "Later" sounded interchangeable, and only one is permanent. This release also carries the stronger v2 + v3 app signing introduced in 1.8.7.4, which the previous update could not deliver to anyone already on that version.
